name: mgid-mcp
description: MGID (ads): me, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_mgid_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MGID_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mgid_api_token.description: 32-character MGID REST API token from the MGID Ads dashboard (Settings > API), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

platform_mcp_mgid_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MGID_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mgid_client_id.description: The advertiser's MGID client (account) id; every campaign path is /goodhits/clients/{client_id}/…

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/clients/{client_id}: the client's financial status {id, timezone, wallet {balance, credit, income, currency}} (amounts in cents). API version 1 (the public reference); v2 docs are only inside the dashboard.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /v1/goodhits/clients/{client_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id} with limitType=budget_limits and dailyLimit (two decimals, account currency; the minimum depends on currency and campaign type). This spends money. Parameters are sent in the query string, as the reference's PATCH examples do. The existing overallLimit is not sent (it must stay above the daily limit). A refusal comes back as {errors: [...]}. `currency` is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /v1/goodhits/clients/{client_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id} with whetherToBlockByClient=1 (pause: lock the campaign) or 0 (resume: unlock), sent in the query string. Resuming restarts spend.
